about: Hand labels for the FIRST drafts of LIVE32 run 2 (decision_verification_live_answers_run2.json, collected 2026-10-16 after the verifier was adjusted to run-1 failures - so run 2 is NOT an independent held-out for the rules; it measures the deployed pipeline on new LLM samples).
